reports.verdict: Cloud growth doubled, but record spending and negative cash flow spooked investors.

reasons.label: Cash burn
reasons.text: Free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion as spending outran cash from operations.

reasons.label: Huge AI spending
reasons.text: Capex reached $51.4 billion for the quarter, more than double last year's $24.0 billion.

reasons.label: Rising costs
reasons.text: Research costs rose 36% and borrowing costs climbed; debt more than doubled to $125 billion this year.

reports.verdict: Solid beat, but cautious 2027 outlook and rising bank payments left the stock about flat.

reasons.label: Cooler 2027 outlook
reasons.text: Visa guided to low-double-digit revenue growth next year, versus 15% this year; some investors found that modest.

reasons.label: Rising payments to banks
reasons.text: Payments to banks and partners to keep them on Visa jumped 21% to $5.1B; about 25% of volume renews in 2027.

reasons.label: Costs growing faster
reasons.text: Adjusted operating expenses rose 12%, mostly marketing and staff, and 2027 profit growth is guided slightly below revenue growth.
